summary: QUANTIFY the tree branch/superset upside: what accept/event gain SHOULD top-2 branches deliver at temp0.6 if verify were lossless (rejection-sampling math on the drafter q from EXISTING traces)? Is >native plausible post-carrier-fix, or is the tree at best native-parity? Also: is the deployed topology actually the intended caterpillar, and why did branches add 0 in every run (contamination vs topology vs committer)? CPU read-only.

synthesis.deployed_topology_verdict: CATERPILLAR (not two-parallel-chains). Deployed tree = 9-node depth-5 pure-causal spine (slots [0,1,3,5,7]) + per-position drafter-top-2 sibling leaf at depths 2-5 (slots [2,4,6,8]); parents [-1,0,0,1,1,3,3,5,5]. The branch slots hold GENUINE per-position top-2: each leaf is torch.topk(step_logits,2)[1] from the SAME logits that produced that depth's greedy spine token, conditioned on the pure spine prefix (only spine tokens fed back; leaves never advance state) — NOT wrong-conditioning chain-2 continuations. The stock propose_tree child_drafts=[1,2,1,1,1] hazard (project_fr10_drafter_topology_mismatch) is BYPASSED entirely: the FR10_CATERPILLAR_NATIVE_SPINE_TOP2 branch (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:5439-5640) engages on exact shape match with a fail-loud RuntimeError on mismatch, and the runtime B4 gate verified topology PASS (matches_expected_top1_top2_tree=true, 193/193 rows, spine byte-identical to native MTP-5). The buggy two-chains layout survives only in the old capture-probe script default. ONE structural deviation from the ideal superset: NO sibling at depth 1 — root top-2 is computed but dead code (patch :5470) — and step-0 is where 62% of all reject-steps land, so the largest reject bucket has no branch rescue. Caveat: repo-committed defaults inspected; a live boot could override TREE via env (output/ run envs not audited).
synthesis.expected_bonus_range: With working branches (post-carrier-fix), expected accept/event = 3.24-3.44 on the E5 anchor (pessimistic argmax-adjacent-only +0.17, trace-based +0.21, optimistic P2=a_d +0.36 over the depth-matched K=5 spine of 3.076; 3.0-3.2 on the June-9 prompt mix). That is a real but modest +5-12% bonus over SAME-DEPTH native — and it does NOT reach the 3.6-3.8 comparator, because that comparator is K=9 LINEAR (9 drafted tokens), not depth-5: closing that gap needs +0.54..+0.72, beyond even the optimistic +0.36. At equal 9-slot verify budget the K=9 linear chain beats the 9-node caterpillar under every bound (deep-chain tail worth more than sibling second-chances). Committer math makes leaves purely additive (accept prob p1+p2; spine-continue stays p1), bonus per reached sibling step = E[p2]≈0.12-0.15, P(cand2 accepted | cand1 rejected)=0.38-0.63 by depth. KEY SENSITIVITY: p2/b_d are measured on verify-CORRUPTED runs where 120/137 branch accepts sat on spine-zero rows and 95-97% of cand2 mass is argmax-adjacent under the corrupted target — a degenerate ~+0 healthy floor cannot be excluded, and healthy verify raises p1, mechanically squeezing residual p2. Cheap incremental wins quantified: root sibling (1,) adds +0.08..+0.15 (attacks the 62% step-0 reject bucket); continuation-chains-under-cand2 topology is the only modeled route to K=9 parity (optimistic 3.61-3.88).
synthesis.why_zero_ranked: RANK 1 — CONTAMINATION (the carrier; dominant and sufficient in every post-06-04 measured run), via three channels: (a) root reject 36.6-38.4% on a SINGLE candidate byte-identical to native's first draft, with target_prob_at_draft=[0.0] — 62% of all reject-steps, no branch slot at depth 0; (b) reject_steps_both_zero = 355/391 (90.8%) — when the spine rejects at depths 1-4 the branch sits on the same annihilated verify row, so branch death is co-located with spine death; (c) 120/137 branch accepts occurred where the spine child had ZERO verify probability — mostly artifacts, only 17 genuine both-positive wins. Net arithmetic: spine alone should give ≥3.79 (byte-identical to native), measured 2.024 — the spine loses ~1.77/event to contamination, swamping the +0.21/event gross branch bonus = the apparent "net zero." RANK 2 — TOPOLOGY: real and code-verified for stock propose_tree (two parallel chains; slots 4,6,8 = wrong-conditioning chain-2 continuations) and it genuinely zeroed branches in the 2026-06-04-era runs (branch event fraction 0.0038), but it is PATCHED OUT and gate-verified absent in every run behind the headline claim (FR13_COMMITTER_TOPOLOGY_REDTEAM.md refutes it for those runs; the stale line in FR13_DIRECTION_AND_NUMBERS.md:60 is outdated). RANK 3 — COMMITTER: RULED OUT by code + traces; greedy max-LCP enumerates all root-to-leaf paths, canonical_multidraft fired at temp 0.6 and followed source_index=1 into branches 137 times; conditional branch survival where a sibling existed = 48.1%; gate classification committer_break=false, verify_or_target_row_break=true. BONUS FINDING: the headline "branches added 0" is partly a measurement artifact — vLLM's per-pos counter indexes accepted-path-length (pos5-8=0 is STRUCTURAL for a depth-5 tree, output/fr13_argmax_e2e_20260608T055851Z); the correct instrument (source-index trace) shows +0.21/event gross, not zero.
synthesis.endgame_call: SPLIT VERDICT, comparator-dependent. "Lossless + FASTER than native" is plausible ONLY against the depth-matched K=5 native (E5, 3.076): the branch bonus is real-but-modest (+0.17..+0.36 accept/event, +5-12%), with named conditions: (1) Method A carrier fix lands and the spine recovers to ~3.08 (supported: root-accept events already averaged 2.77 accepted_len under corruption), (2) branch verify ROWS are also de-contaminated (all-8 native-on-branch-path oracle only 13/17 — same carrier), (3) healthy b_d does not collapse toward the unexcludable ~+0 floor (the corrupted-run transfer caveat is the single biggest risk), (4) the 9-slot verify + TREE_ATTN per-event overhead doesn't eat the +5-12% in wall-clock TPS. Against the DEPLOYED comparator (K=9 linear native at 3.62-3.79), the realistic endgame is "LOSSLESS AT NATIVE-PARITY + INFRA": the 9-node caterpillar cannot beat a 9-token linear chain at equal verify budget under any bound — the gap (+0.54..+0.72) exceeds even the optimistic branch bonus, and the only modeled routes past it (root sibling +0.08..+0.15, continuation-chains-under-cand2 → 3.61-3.88, deeper spine) are DRAFTER/topology work, out of verify scope. Recommended framing: bank the lossless tree-verify infrastructure now, claim a modest superset win vs depth-matched native if the paired capture confirms healthy b_d, and treat "faster than the K=9 deployment" as a follow-on drafter project — do not promise it from this tree.
synthesis.cheapest_decisive_measurement: ONE paired boot post-Method-A (conv prior-window fix in): healthy tree arm + native arm, B=4, temp 0.6 / top_p 0.95, on the PINNED same-8 prompts (save request.json/prompt_token_ids at capture per the capture-once rule), with the already-existing logging — tree_path_lcp.jsonl (per-step p1, p2, target_argmax, selected_source_index) on the tree arm and per_req_spec_trace.jsonl on the native arm. This single capture pins: healthy spine a_d (does the spine recover to ~3.08?), healthy E[p2 | reached, cand1-rejected] (is the branch bonus +0.2-0.36 or degenerate ~0?), the true argmax-adjacency rate, and root-reject rate — replacing every assumption in bounds (i)-(iii) with measurements and deciding parity-vs-faster in one run. No new instrumentation needed; readers fr10_superset_gate.load_tree_accept_trace/load_spec_trace already exist.

overreaches: why_zero_ranked: 'spine alone should give >=3.79 (byte-identical to native), measured 2.024 -- spine loses ~1.77/event' is arithmetically wrong. The 3.7945 native (b4_superset_cpu_gate.json native_summary) is K=9 LINEAR (9 drafted tokens); a byte-identical DEPTH-5 spine under healthy verify yields E[min(A,5)] ~= 2.77-2.87 on those prompts by the synthesis's OWN constant-a fit (and its own endgame condition (1) says 'recovers to ~3.08'). True contamination loss on the spine is ~0.75-0.85/event, not 1.77 -- still ~4x the +0.21 branch bonus so RANK-1 contamination survives, but the headline loss figure is ~2x overstated and internally inconsistent with SYN's own 'comparator is K=9, not depth-5' correction.

Labeling +0.17 (3.24) as the 'pessimistic' bound while simultaneously admitting 'a degenerate ~+0 healthy floor cannot be excluded'. The argmax-adjacent bound is computed from the CORRUPTED-target argmax -- exactly the quantity under suspicion -- so it is a trace-conditional bound, not a floor. The honest pessimistic edge of the post-fix range is ~3.08 (spine-only recovery, branch bonus ~0), making the defensible range 3.08-3.44, with 3.24-3.44 conditional on corrupted-trace b_d transferring.

'At equal 9-slot verify budget the K=9 linear chain beats the 9-node caterpillar under every bound' overstates: no same-prompt K=9-vs-tree measurement exists (E5 prompts have no K=9 native run; the flat-a extrapolation 4.16 is known to over-predict; depth>=6 a_d is unmeasured; E5 = 8 prompts vs June-9 = 4x4). Directionally well-supported (even the optimistic tree 3.44 < 3.62 measured on the easier comparator's own mix), but it is a modeled cross-prompt-set inference, not a bound that holds 'under every' condition.

Minor: 'root reject 36.6-38.4% ... with target_prob_at_draft=[0.0]' generalizes the zero-probability property from the gate JSON's logged reject0 EXAMPLES (canonical_accept_prob=0.0 in sampled rows) to all root rejects; the gate does not publish an all-root-rejects zero-prob count.

Minor: 'the runtime B4 gate verified topology PASS (..., spine byte-identical to native MTP-5)' conflates two artifacts -- the topology/metadata PASS (193/193, matches_expected_top1_top2_tree=true) is in b4_superset_cpu_gate.json, while spine byte-identity comes from a separate draft trace (fr10_mtp_draft_trace.jsonl per FR13_COMMITTER_TOPOLOGY_REDTEAM.md); both exist, but they are not one gate output.
verify.corrected: VERDICT: synthesis HOLDS with corrections. (1) DATA BASIS -- the bonus range is anchored on REAL traces, independently re-verified: E5 per_req_spec_trace.jsonl (output/fr10_native_mtp5_same8_20260604T210257Z) re-parses to 512 events, hist {0:80,1:63,2:60,3:55,4:43,5:211}, accept/event 3.0762, a_d [0.844,0.854,0.837,0.822,0.831]; corrupted-run branch quantities re-verified in output/fr13_swe_verified_b4_diag_20260609T190931Z/b4_superset_cpu_gate.json (source counts {0:1140,1:137}, both_zero 355/391, reject_step_counts {0:243,1:60,2:38,3:39,4:11} = 62% at step 0, branch_source1_top1_zero 120/137, native 3.7945, tree 2.0242, topology PASS 193/193) and output/fr13_corruption_b4_gate_20260609T194841Z (root reject 201/549 = 36.6%). Bonus arithmetic recomputes exactly (sibling rejected mass 0.432; trace +0.214; optimistic +0.361). Only the optimistic P2=a_d bound is assumed; the rest is measured-but-corrupted. (2) RANGE, CORRECTED: post-carrier-fix expected accept/event on the E5 anchor = 3.08 (honest floor: spine-only recovery, the unexcludable degenerate ~+0 branch case) to 3.44 (optimistic P2=a_d), with 3.29 as the trace-conditional central estimate (+0.21, valid only if corrupted-run b_d=[0.46,0.53,0.38,0.63] transfers to healthy verify -- the single biggest assumption, since 120/137 observed branch accepts sat on spine-zero rows and 95-97% of cand2 mass is corrupted-target argmax-adjacent). Do not call 3.24 'pessimistic'. Structural cap given this topology = 3.076+0.432 = 3.51 (perfect branches recover ALL sibling-step rejected mass); absolute depth-5 ceiling = 5.0; branches only recover rejected mass below these ceilings, never exceed them. (3) WHY-ZERO, CORRECTED: contamination remains RANK 1 and the committer remains ruled out, but the spine-loss arithmetic must read: healthy depth-5 spine on the June-9 mix ~= 2.77-2.87 (K=5 truncation of the K=9 native 3.62-3.79; the >=3.79 spine-only figure wrongly borrowed the K=9 comparator), so contamination costs the spine ~0.75-0.85/event vs the +0.21/event gross branch bonus -- still a ~4x dominance, same ranking, half the previously claimed magnitude. The 'branches added 0' headline stays partly a measurement artifact (per-pos counter is accepted-path-length-indexed; pos5-8=0 is structural for depth-5; verified in output/fr13_argmax_e2e_20260608T055851Z/metrics_after_probe.txt: pos0-4 = 326/238/134/96/68, pos5-8 = 0). (4) TOPOLOGY: verdict CONFIRMED against deployed code, not just memory -- 9-node caterpillar TREE in scripts/fr10_launch_speed_server.sh:82 and scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh; FR10_CATERPILLAR_NATIVE_SPINE_TOP2 exact-shape guard at scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:5439-5455 with fail-loud RuntimeError at 5652-5663; _fr10_top2 at :5470 confirmed dead code (single occurrence), so NO depth-1 sibling where 62% of rejects land; runtime gate matches_expected_top1_top2_tree=true 193/193. Keep the live-env-override caveat. (5) ENDGAME, CORRECTED: split verdict stands -- vs depth-matched K=5 native (3.076), 'lossless + modestly faster' is plausible but CONDITIONAL (carrier fix lands AND spine recovers to ~3.08 AND branch rows de-contaminate (oracle currently 13/17) AND healthy b_d does not collapse to ~0 AND 9-slot+TREE_ATTN overhead does not eat +5-12% in TPS); vs the K=9 linear deployment (3.62-3.79), even optimistic branches (+0.36) fall short of the needed +0.54..+0.72, so frame as lossless-at-parity + infrastructure -- but state this as a strongly-supported cross-prompt-set model inference, not 'under every bound' (no same-prompt K=9-vs-tree run exists; depth>=6 a_d unmeasured). (6) DECISIVE NEXT STEP unchanged and correct: one paired post-Method-A boot on the pinned same-8 prompts (save request.json/prompt_token_ids), tree arm with existing tree_path_lcp.jsonl logging + native arm per_req_spec_trace.jsonl, replacing every remaining assumption (healthy a_d, healthy E[p2|reached,cand1-rejected], argmax-adjacency, root-reject rate) with measurements in a single run.
